question: How many unused PTO days can I carry over into the next year?
answer: Up to 5 unused days of PTO may be carried over into the next calendar year. [1]

question: How much notice do I need to give for a PTO request of more than 3 consecutive days?
answer: For absences of up to 3 consecutive working days, submit the request at least 2 working days in advance. [1] For absences of more than 3 consecutive working days, submit the request at least 2 weeks in advance. [1]

question: How many floating holidays do employees get each year?
answer: New employees who join after 30 June receive 1 floating holiday for their first calendar year instead of 2. [1]

question: What compensation do I get if I work on a public holiday?
answer: pay at 2 times their normal rate for the hours worked (for salaried employees this is calculated from their daily rate); and. [1] one day off in lieu, which must be taken within 60 days of the holiday worked. [1]

question: How many paid sick days do full-time employees get per year?
answer: Full-time employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year at full pay. [1]

question: When do I need a doctor's note for a sickness absence?
answer: A doctor's note (medical certificate) is required for any sickness absence of more than 3 consecutive calendar days. [1] Acme Corp may also request a doctor's note if an employee has more than 4 separate periods of sickness absence in 12 months. [1]
